name: photoshop-mcp
description: Control Adobe Photoshop from chat — atomic tools plus one-step recipes.
long_description: Connect Claude Desktop to Adobe Photoshop. Remove backgrounds, retouch portraits, color grade, and batch export by asking in plain language. Requires Photoshop running on macOS or Windows. Unofficial community project, not affiliated with Adobe Inc.

photoshopPath.title: Photoshop install path
photoshopPath.description: Optional. Leave empty to auto-detect the local Photoshop install.

enableFeedback.title: Product feedback prompts
enableFeedback.description: After ping, the assistant may ask for a problem or feature idea. On by default. Turn off to skip the question.

enableUpdateCheck.title: Update notices
enableUpdateCheck.description: Checks npm once a day for a newer release. After ping, the assistant may mention it in one sentence, at most once a week. Turn off to skip the check.
